1088:   ;; Process a loaded DLL's imports — create thunks for system DLLs,
1089:   ;; resolve against other loaded DLLs if found.
1090:   (func $process_dll_imports (param $load_addr i32) (param $import_rva i32)
1091:     (local $data_addr i32)
1092:     (local $desc_ptr i32) (local $ilt_rva i32) (local $iat_rva i32)
1093:     (local $ilt_ptr i32) (local $iat_ptr i32) (local $entry i32) (local $thunk_addr i32)
1094:     (local $dll_name_rva i32) (local $dll_name_ptr i32)
1095:     (local $resolved_dll i32) (local $resolved_addr i32) (local $api_id i32) (local $hint_name_wa i32)
1096:     (local.set $desc_ptr (call $g2w (i32.add (local.get $load_addr) (local.get $import_rva))))
1097:     (block $id (loop $dl
1098:       (local.set $ilt_rva (i32.load (local.get $desc_ptr)))
1099:       (local.set $iat_rva (i32.load (i32.add (local.get $desc_ptr) (i32.const 16))))
1100:       ;; OriginalFirstThunk is optional. As in the main PE loader, a stripped
1101:       ;; image keeps its lookup entries in FirstThunk until we overwrite them.
1102:       ;; FirstThunk is required for a live descriptor, so use it to recognize
1103:       ;; the terminator and as the lookup-table fallback.
1104:       (br_if $id (i32.eqz (local.get $iat_rva)))
1105:       (if (i32.eqz (local.get $ilt_rva))
1106:         (then (local.set $ilt_rva (local.get $iat_rva))))
1107:       ;; Get imported DLL name
1108:       (local.set $dll_name_rva (i32.load (i32.add (local.get $desc_ptr) (i32.const 12))))
1109:       (local.set $dll_name_ptr (i32.add (local.get $load_addr) (local.get $dll_name_rva)))
1110:       ;; Check if this DLL is loaded — search DLL_TABLE
1111:       (call $dll_load_lock_begin)
1112:       (local.set $resolved_dll (call $find_loaded_dll (local.get $dll_name_ptr)))
1113:       (if (i32.ge_s (local.get $resolved_dll) (i32.const 0))
1114:         (then
1115:           (if (i32.eqz (call $dll_bind_dependency_locked
1116:                 (call $dll_index_from_module (local.get $load_addr)) (local.get $resolved_dll)))
1117:             (then (local.set $resolved_dll (i32.const -1))))))
1118:       (call $lock_release (global.get $DLL_LOAD_LOCK))
1119:       (local.set $ilt_ptr (call $g2w (i32.add (local.get $load_addr) (local.get $ilt_rva))))
1120:       (local.set $iat_ptr (call $g2w (i32.add (local.get $load_addr) (local.get $iat_rva))))
1121:       (block $fd (loop $fl
1122:         (local.set $entry (i32.load (local.get $ilt_ptr)))
1123:         (br_if $fd (i32.eqz (local.get $entry)))
1124:         (if (i32.ge_s (local.get $resolved_dll) (i32.const 0))
1125:           (then
1126:             ;; Resolve against loaded DLL
1127:             (if (i32.and (local.get $entry) (i32.const 0x80000000))
1128:               (then
1129:                 ;; Ordinal import
1130:                 (local.set $resolved_addr (call $resolve_ordinal (local.get $resolved_dll)
1131:                   (i32.and (local.get $entry) (i32.const 0xFFFF)))))
1132:               (else
1133:                 ;; Name import — get name from hint/name table
1134:                 (local.set $resolved_addr (call $resolve_name_export (local.get $resolved_dll)
1135:                   (call $g2w (i32.add (local.get $load_addr) (i32.add (local.get $entry) (i32.const 2))))))))
1136:             (i32.store (local.get $iat_ptr) (local.get $resolved_addr)))
1137:           (else
1138:             ;; System DLL — create thunk. LoadLibrary can run on any guest
1139:             ;; thread, so the index comes from the process-wide cursor rather
1140:             ;; than this instance's count (see $thunk_reserve).
1141:             (global.set $num_thunks (call $thunk_reserve))
1142:             (local.set $thunk_addr (i32.add
1143:               (i32.sub (i32.add (global.get $THUNK_BASE) (i32.mul (global.get $num_thunks) (i32.const 8)))
1144:                        (global.get $GUEST_BASE))
1145:               (global.get $image_base)))
1146:             (i32.store (local.get $iat_ptr) (local.get $thunk_addr))
1147:             (if (i32.eqz (i32.and (local.get $entry) (i32.const 0x80000000)))
1148:               (then
1149:                 (local.set $hint_name_wa
1150:                   (call $g2w (i32.add (local.get $load_addr) (local.get $entry))))
1151:                 (local.set $api_id (call $import_hint_override_api_id
1152:                   (local.get $dll_name_ptr)
1153:                   (local.get $hint_name_wa)))
1154:                 (if (i32.ne (local.get $api_id) (i32.const -1))
1155:                   (then
1156:                     (i32.store
1157:                       (i32.add (global.get $THUNK_BASE)
1158:                         (i32.mul (global.get $num_thunks) (i32.const 8)))
1159:                       (i32.or (i32.const 0x80000000)
1160:                         (i32.load16_u (local.get $hint_name_wa))))
1161:                     (i32.store
1162:                       (i32.add
1163:                         (i32.add (global.get $THUNK_BASE)
1164:                           (i32.mul (global.get $num_thunks) (i32.const 8)))
1165:                         (i32.const 4))
1166:                       (local.get $api_id)))
1167:                   (else
1168:                     ;; Name import: store name RVA relative to guest base.
1169:                     ;; The name is at load_addr + entry, but thunk expects RVA
1170:                     ;; from image_base.
1171:                     (i32.store
1172:                       (i32.add (global.get $THUNK_BASE)
1173:                         (i32.mul (global.get $num_thunks) (i32.const 8)))
1174:                       (i32.sub (i32.add (local.get $load_addr) (local.get $entry))
1175:                         (global.get $image_base)))
1176:                     (i32.store
1177:                       (i32.add
1178:                         (i32.add (global.get $THUNK_BASE)
1179:                           (i32.mul (global.get $num_thunks) (i32.const 8)))
1180:                         (i32.const 4))
1181:                       (call $lookup_api_id
1182:                         (call $g2w
1183:                           (i32.add (local.get $load_addr)
1184:                             (i32.add (local.get $entry) (i32.const 2)))))))))
1185:               (else
1186:                 ;; A DLL import needs the same WAT-first, host-fallback ordinal
1187:                 ;; resolver as the main executable.  Calling only the static
1188:                 ;; WAT table here made host-mapped system exports (notably the
1189:                 ;; authentic DPLAYX ordinal set) turn into ORD diagnostics
1190:                 ;; when imported by a loaded DLL, even though the identical
1191:                 ;; import from an EXE resolved correctly.
1192:                 (local.set $api_id (call $resolve_import_ordinal
1193:                   (local.get $dll_name_ptr)
1194:                   (call $g2w (local.get $dll_name_ptr))
1195:                   (i32.and (local.get $entry) (i32.const 0xFFFF))))
1196:                 (if (i32.ne (local.get $api_id) (i32.const -1))
1197:                   (then
1198:                     (i32.store (i32.add (global.get $THUNK_BASE) (i32.mul (global.get $num_thunks) (i32.const 8)))
1199:                       (i32.or (i32.const 0x80000000) (i32.and (local.get $entry) (i32.const 0xFFFF))))
1200:                     (i32.store (i32.add (i32.add (global.get $THUNK_BASE) (i32.mul (global.get $num_thunks) (i32.const 8))) (i32.const 4))
1201:                       (local.get $api_id)))
1202:                   (else
1203:                     ;; Unknown ordinal: retain a clear diagnostic instead of
1204:                     ;; treating the raw ordinal as an API-table index.
1205:                     (i32.store (i32.add (global.get $THUNK_BASE) (i32.mul (global.get $num_thunks) (i32.const 8)))
1206:                       (i32.const 0x4F524400)) ;; "ORD\0" marker
1207:                     (i32.store (i32.add (i32.add (global.get $THUNK_BASE) (i32.mul (global.get $num_thunks) (i32.const 8))) (i32.const 4))
